en.title: Vision-based robot teleoperation
en.lead: A stereo hand-tracking pipeline connecting 3D perception to UR5e motion.
en.overview: Two cameras estimate hand position in 3D. Calibration, triangulation and Kalman filtering connect visual input to the robot-control pipeline.
work: Stereo camera calibration and paired image capture.
Hand-landmark triangulation and coordinate filtering.
Integration and documentation with the project team.
steps: Two camera views and hand landmarks.
Hand positions map to UR5e commands.
en.outcome: The repository includes the camera workflow, filtering and robot integration. The available plots support a qualitative comparison; repeated-trial accuracy and latency benchmarks are not established.

zh.title: 基于视觉的机器人遥操作
zh.tag: 计算机视觉 · 机器人
zh.lead: 通过双目手部追踪，将三维感知连接到 UR5e 运动控制。
zh.overview: 两台摄像头估计手部三维位置。相机标定、三角测量和卡尔曼滤波将视觉输入连接到机器人控制管线。
work: 双目标定与配对图像采集。
手部关键点三角测量与坐标滤波。
与团队共同完成系统集成和文档。
steps: 双摄像头画面与手部关键点。
通过标定后的几何关系计算三维坐标。
卡尔曼滤波平滑位置估计。
将手部位置映射为 UR5e 指令。
zh.outcome: 仓库包含相机流程、滤波与机器人集成。现有曲线可用于定性比较，但未建立多次试验的精度与延迟基准。
gallery: 原始轨迹与卡尔曼滤波后的轨迹。

en.title: Wearable ECG monitoring
en.lead: A team prototype combining wearable electrodes, ECG acquisition, Bluetooth and a mobile waveform interface.
en.overview: The original project connects an electrode concept to ECG acquisition and wireless display. The illustrated archive follows circuit design, PCB routing, enclosure studies and physical prototyping.
work: PCB design and circuit integration within the team.
ECG filtering and signal-processing experiments.
WeChat mini-program development for acquisition and waveform display.
steps: Electrodes, acquisition circuit and enclosure studies.
en.outcome: The rebuilt repository includes original hardware evidence, repaired software and a public ECG explorer. Its beat-detection evaluation uses one supplied MIT-BIH record. Native CAD/fabrication files and clinical validation were not supplied.
gallery: Original boards, enclosure parts and electrode forms.

zh.title: 可穿戴心电监测系统
zh.tag: 生物信号 · 硬件设计
zh.lead: 结合可穿戴电极、心电采集、蓝牙与移动端波形显示的团队原型。
meta: PCB · 滤波 · 微信小程序
zh.overview: 原项目将电极概念连接到心电采集与无线显示。图文仓库展示电路设计、PCB 布线、外壳建模与实物制作过程。
work: 参与 PCB 设计与电路集成。
心电滤波与信号处理实验。
开发微信小程序的采集与波形显示功能。
steps: 电极、采集电路与外壳方案。
电路板与可穿戴部件原型。
蓝牙采集与移动端显示。
zh.outcome: 重建仓库包含原始硬件图片、修复的软件及在线心电查看工具。心搏检测评测仅使用提供的一条 MIT-BIH 记录。未提供原生 CAD、制造文件或临床验证。
gallery: 原始电路板、外壳部件与电极形态。

en.title: DeltaV nitration process control
en.lead: A bachelor thesis covering coordinated control, startup logic and operator supervision in DeltaV.
en.overview: The thesis studies temperature–flow cascade control and a feed-ratio follower, alongside system architecture, I/O, startup sequencing, alarms and operator displays.
work: Analyzed process requirements and compared control structures.
Designed control modules, startup sequence and alarm logic.
Developed operator displays and reviewed simulated trends.
steps: Process requirements, system architecture and I/O.
en.outcome: The original work is theoretical and simulation-level research. The new browser demo makes cascade, ratio, disturbance and trip/reset behavior visible through a normalized teaching model. It does not reproduce a commissioned plant or a native DeltaV configuration.

zh.title: 基于 DeltaV 的硝化过程控制
zh.lead: 本科毕业设计，涵盖 DeltaV 协调控制、开车逻辑与操作员监控。
zh.overview: 论文研究温度—流量串级控制及进料比例跟随，并设计系统架构、I/O、开车顺控、报警与操作员画面。
work: 分析过程需求并比较控制结构。
设计控制模块、开车顺序与报警逻辑。
制作操作员画面并分析仿真趋势。
steps: 过程需求、系统架构与 I/O。
模块、顺控与操作员画面。
zh.outcome: 原项目属于理论与仿真研究。新增浏览器演示使用归一化教学模型展示串级、比例、扰动与跳闸复位行为，并非已投产装置或原生 DeltaV 配置的复现。
gallery: 原始控制器与工作站设计。
原始串级与比例控制图。

en.title: Children’s waste sorting app
en.lead: A WeChat learning project rebuilt as a bilingual browser app with a sorting game, dictionary and photo workflow.
en.overview: The original project helps children learn waste classification through recognition, search and play. Little Sorters brings that learning flow to a standalone browser app.
work: Developed the sorting game, scoring and feedback.
Integrated the game with a teammate’s recognition feature.
Documented the workflow and recognition-test limitations.
steps: Photo input or an object-name query.
Review candidate labels or enter a name.
Map the object to the original dictionary.
en.outcome: The rebuilt app supports English/Chinese, dictionary search and offline use. Its public photo lab is a recorded-example demonstration; live Baidu recognition requires the optional local server. Raspberry Pi was the original project context, with no completed Pi hardware prototype verified in the archive.

zh.title: 儿童垃圾分类学习应用
zh.tag: 应用 AI · 学习产品
zh.lead: 将微信学习项目重建为双语浏览器应用，包含分类游戏、词典与照片查询流程。
meta: JavaScript · 微信 · 百度 API
浏览器应用 · 离线支持
zh.overview: 原项目通过识别、搜索与游戏帮助儿童学习垃圾分类。Little Sorters 将学习流程迁移到独立的浏览器应用。
work: 开发分类游戏、计分与反馈。
将游戏与队友的识别功能集成。
记录操作流程与识别测试中的局限。
steps: 选择候选名称或手动输入。
将名称匹配到原始分类词典。
zh.outcome: 重建应用支持中英文、词典查询与离线使用。公开照片实验室是已记录示例的演示；实时百度识别需使用可选的本地服务。树莓派是原始项目背景，档案中未确认完整的树莓派硬件原型。
gallery: 2026 年重建，包含游戏与搜索。
